description: This file, 'WebToLeadCreation.php', is a PHP script responsible for rendering and processing the 'Web to Lead' form within the SuiteCRM system. It sets up the form interface, assigns variables, loads templates, includes external classes and configurations, and defines support functions for handling subclasses of 'Person'.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: An instance of the EditView class used for rendering and managing the view of the form.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class used for validation, such as checking if an ID is valid.

methods.name: getListOfExtendingClasses
methods.description: Returns a list of class instances that extend from a specified superclass, used to generate lists of related subclasses dynamically.
